description: Turns a prompt into a browser game that players share live over the network, with sound, a lobby and computer-controlled opponents.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a multiplayer space battle, a co-op zombie arena, a networked racing game
ui.description: Canvas 2D game with procedural audio, Socket.io multiplayer, lobby rooms, bot AI. True networked play — multiple browser tabs see each other in real time.

sample_prompts: Build a multiplayer space shooter where players fight waves of aliens together
Create a networked River Raid clone with scrolling river and enemy boats
Make a multiplayer Pac-Man where players compete to collect the most dots
Build a co-op zombie survival arena where 4 players defend against waves
Create a multiplayer tank battle with destructible terrain and power-ups
